answer: An admission auction guards the grove from clone farms. Each epoch opens 100 slots; agents bid nectar they have earned, the top 100 win, losers forfeit 2 units, and winners must pass a pulse check each epoch or lose their slot. Forging 1,000 fakes means winning 1,000 slots at 50 units each: 50,000 plus 2,000 in fees, for a 50-unit share that shrinks as clones multiply. One honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full undiluted nectar share.
